senses.gloss: रं॑सु mfn. (fr. √ रन्, or रम्) cheerful, delightful (only ˚उ ind. delightfully), RV. ii, 4, 5.
रं॑सु ind., delightfully
रं॑सु—जिह्व (रं॑सु-), mfn. having a pleasing tongue or voice, RV.
रंह = रंहस् (see वात-रंह).
रंहण n. going swiftly, hastening, MW.
रंहति f. speed, velocity (of a chariot), W.
रंहस् n. speed, quickness, velocity, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
eagerness, impetuosity, BhP.
रंहस् m. N. of Śiva (Vehemence personified), MBh.
of Viṣṇu, Hariv.
रंहस (ifc.) = रंहस् (e.g. मनो-मारुतर्˚, having the swiftness of thought or of the wind, Hariv.)
रं॑हि f. running, flowing, hastening, speed, velocity, eagerness, impetuosity, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.
a flowing stream, RV.
a running horse, courser, ib.
(accord. to some also, ‘glory, might, power &c.’).
रंहित mfn. hastening, quick, rapid, Kauś.
रन् See √ 1. रण्.
2. र॑न् (meaning doubtful), RV. i, 120, 7 (accord. to Sāy. = रातारौ or दातारौ, ‘givers’, fr. √ आ, the sg. being substituted for the du.)
रन्ध् See √ रध्.
रन्ध m. (prob.) subjection, destruction, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 1, 61.
रन्धक mfn. subduing, destroying id.
रन्धक mf(इका)n. the sheath of a knife, L.
रन्धन mfn. destroying (in अभद्र-र्˚), BhP.
रन्धन n. destruction, ib. cooking, TS., Sch.
रन्धनाय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make subject, deliver into the power of (dat.), RV.
रन्धस् or रन्˚धस, m. N. of a man belonging to the family of Andhaka (cf. रान्धस).
रन्धस् or रन्˚धस, m. N. of a man belonging to the family of Andhaka (cf. रान्धस).
रान्धस m. patr. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 144, Sch.
र॑न्धि f. (for र॑न्द्धि) subjection, subjugation, RV.
the being prepared or cooked, BhP.
रन्धित mfn. subdued, destroyed, MW.
cooked, dressed (as food), L.
रन्धिन् See साधु-र्˚.
रन्धिष m. = हन्तृ, a destroyer, VS.
रन्तव्य , 2. रन्ति, रन्तु, रन्तृ. See under √ रम्, p. 868, col. 1.
रन्तव्य mfn. to be rejoiced at or enjoyed, to be toyed with or carnally known, Mṛcch.
रन्तव्य n. pleasure, enjoyment, play, MW.
1. र॑न्ति m. (√ 1. रण्) a fighter, warrior (?), RV. vii, 18, 10; ix, 102, 5.
2. र॑न्ति f. (for 1. See p. 866, col. 3) loving to stay, abiding gladly with (loc.), AV.; VS.
pleasure, delight (used as a term of endearment for a cow), TS.; VS.; PañcavBr.
र॑न्ति m. N. of a lexicographer (= रन्ति-देव), Śiś., Sch.
र॑न्त्य mfn. (√ रम् ?) pleasant, comfortable, RV.; AV.
रन्दला f. N. of Saṃjñā (wife of the Sun), Cat.

र॑न्ध्र n. rarely m. (prob. fr. √ रद्) a slit, split, opening, aperture, hole, chasm, fissure, cavity, RV. &c. &c. (nine openings are reckoned in the human body, cf. under ख; and sometimes a tenth in the skull, as in the fontanel of an infant)
the vulva, BhP.
a partic. part of a horse's head, VarBṛS.; Śiś. (cf. उप-र्˚)
a defect, fault, flaw, imperfection, weak part, Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (cf. छिद्र)
N. of the 8th astrological mansion, VarBṛS.
of the number ‘nine’ (cf. above), MW.
र॑न्ध्र m. N. of a son of Manu Bhautya, VP. (v.l. ब्रध्न)
the off spring of a Brāhman and a Maitrī, L.
रन्ध्र—कण्ट m. a species of acacia, L.
रन्ध्र—गुप्ति f. concealing one's weak points, Kām.
रन्ध्र—प्रहारिन् mfn. attacking the weak places (of an enemy), Ragh.
रन्ध्र—बभ्रु m. a rat, L.
रन्ध्र—वंश m. hollow bamboo, L.
रन्ध्रागत n. a disease which attacks the throat of horses, MBh.
रन्ध्रानुसारिन् mf(इणी)n. seeking for weak or assailable points, Mṛcch.
रन्ध्रान्वेषण n. the act of seeking for weak places, MW.
रन्ध्रान्वेषिन् mfn. = रन्ध्रानुसारिन्, ib.
रन्ध्रापेक्षिन् mfn. watching for weak places, spying out holes, ib.
रन्ध्रोपनिपातिन् mfn. rushing in through holes or weak places (said of misfortunes), Śak.
रन्ध्रक mf(इका)n. = रन्ध्र, in बहुरन्ध्रिका, q.v.
रन्ति—देव m. N. of Viṣṇu, L.

of a king of the lunar race (son of Saṃkṛti; he spent his riches in performing grand sacrifices and the blood which issued from the bodies of the slaughtered victims was changed into a river called चर्मण्-वती, Sch. on Megh. 46), MBh.; Kāv.; Pur.
of another king, Hcar.
of a teacher of Yoga and various authors, esp. of a lexicographer (= रन्ति), Cat.
a dog, W.
रन्ति—नार or रन्ति—भार, m. N. of a king, BhP.
रन्ति—नार or रन्ति—भार, m. N. of a king, BhP.
रन्तु f. a way, road, L.
a river, L.
रन्तु-मनस् mfn. inclined to take pleasure, wishing to enjoy sexual intercourse, MW.
र॑न्तृ mfn. gladly abiding with, delighting in (loc.), RV.
रन्तोस् See √ रम् and अ-रन्तोस्.
राण्ड्य or रान्द्र्य mfn. = रमणीय, agreeable, gratifying, Sāy. on RV. vi, 23, 6.
रा॑न्द्र्य See राण्ड्य.
